description: Capability for the main window. Only what the WebView itself calls: notification, dialog and updater are driven from Rust (alerts/notify.rs, commands/system.rs and library.rs, commands/update.rs), and Tauri 2 enforces this ACL at the IPC boundary alone, so granting them here gave the page a door it never needed and the Rust side nothing. opener:allow-open-url is already inside opener:default.
